title: Kitsap History Museum

services.name: Virtual Exhibits
services.desc: Explore the stories, people, and places that shaped Kitsap County through immersive exhibits that bring local history to life. Be transported to the beginning of the last century and take a walk down Main Street. Peak in the jewelers’ shop, the grocers or the photographers and see what life was like In Bremerton over 100 years ago. Follow the history of Kitsap County from the Ice Age and earliest settlers through to World War II with fun and easy to follow stories our our past. Explore the museum with our interactive exhibits that allow young and old alike to experience history first hand. Make a call on our working 1930’s switchboard or type a message to a friend on an manual
